searchText: Can anyone validate/reject/contextualize the links that are being aggregated here for the CDAP program, specifically for sharding. Are they still relevant? If there are better reading materials, maybe you could comment as much in the PR: https://github.com/ethereum-cdap/cohort-zero/pull/39/files For PoS, would the beacon chain annotated spec be relevant? https://github.com/ethereum/annotated-spec Also this for sharding https://vitalik.ca/general/2021/04/07/sharding.html I think a link to the specs themselves should be relevant for PoS https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs In particular the description of what changes with the merge I suspect will be the most relevant to your program. And both it is great in what are the changes to the beacon-chain https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/blob/dev/specs/merge/beacon-chain.md And also the old research post by Buterin with the description is great (it is linked there in the specs) https://ethresear.ch/t/the-eth1-eth2-transition/6265 But also the proposal by <@!425572898787426305> and the documents that inspired the quick merge that is most likely going to happen https://notes.ethereum.org/m9IX3OkkTveXCCOSzGkUiw https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/pull/2257
